scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:sdk && npm run build:cli
scripts.types:starter: node packages/cli/bin/bopli-theme.js types starter-theme && vue-tsc --noEmit -p starter-theme/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run types:test && node --import tsx --test packages/*/test/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run protocol:check && npm run build && npm run types:starter && npm run lint --prefix starter-theme && npm run format:check --prefix starter-theme && npm test --prefix starter-theme && node packages/cli/bin/bopli-theme.js validate starter-theme
scripts.build:starter: npm run build && npm run types:starter && node packages/cli/bin/bopli-theme.js build starter-theme && node --import tsx packages/protocol/scripts/sync-starter-fixture.ts
